hooks.name: kiro-log
hooks.description: When the agent finishes a turn that changed files, add one dated row to docs/KIRO_LOG.md.

action.prompt: The turn has ended. Only if this turn changed one or more files, append exactly one dated row to docs/KIRO_LOG.md that names the files changed and any spec task IDs completed. Describe only what this turn actually did: invent no file, task ID or outcome. If this turn changed no file, do nothing and say nothing. Edit no file other than docs/KIRO_LOG.md.
